title: Exact Conditions: amennyiben and abban az esetben, ha

sections.title: Beyond Everyday 'ha'
sections.content: You know *ha* ... *akkor* from A2 Unit 13 and *amennyiben* from B1 Unit 28. While 'ha' (if) covers general conditional statements in everyday conversation, scientific and technical prose often uses finer tools. 'Amennyiben' (insofar as / provided that / if) introduces an objective prerequisite whose fulfillment determines the main clause. 'Abban az esetben, ha' (in the event that / in the specific case where) narrows the scope to a strictly defined scenario.

sections.title: Stating Assumptions with 'ha ... akkor'
sections.content: To flag a working assumption or hypothesis that must hold true for a deduction to remain valid, state it in a plain 'ha' clause and answer it with 'akkor': 'Ha a mérés pontos, akkor az eredmény is pontos.' Like other Hungarian subordinating conjunctions, 'ha', 'amennyiben' and 'abban az esetben, ha' are preceded by a comma when they follow the main clause.

sections.title: Formal Conditional Conjunctions at B2
rows: in the specific case that / in the event that

items.spanish: A feltevés csak akkor igazolódik be, amennyiben a mérések megismételhetők.
items.english: The hypothesis is confirmed only insofar as the measurements are repeatable.

items.spanish: Ha a hőmérséklet nem változik, akkor az eredmény érvényes marad.
items.english: If the temperature does not change, then the result remains valid.

items.spanish: Abban az esetben, ha új tünet jelentkezik, azonnal módosítjuk a kezelést.
items.english: In the event that a new symptom appears, we immediately modify the treatment.

sections.title: B2 Stylistic Notice
sections.content: Pair 'csak akkor..., amennyiben...' or 'ha..., akkor...' when writing essays to project an authoritative, analytical tone.
